'''''Sakin''''' was a group of four [[Cargo ferry|cargo ferries]] used by Rogue [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Demetrius Zaarin]] during his [[Zaarin insurrection|insurrection]] against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]]. The cargo ferries were present at Zaarin's [[Research]] platform, where he developed the [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter/Legends|TIE Defender]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]], when Loyalist forces sent a strike team to [[Capture of Research|retake]] the platform. One of the cargo ferries escaped into hyperspace but the rest were destroyed in the battle.

==Behind the scenes==
The cargo ferries appear in ''Star Wars: TIE Fighter'' mission, "Capture Platform", the first mission of the game's ninth tour of campaign. This article assumes that one cargo ferry, ''Sakin 1'', escaped into hyperspace. However, it is possible to destroy all cargo ferries before they escape.
